entries.name: Iron Health Doctrine V
entries.text: Unit-unique: +300 HP, unlocks Ironsides: +175 piercing/slashing/blunt defence for 12s. Mandatory per Amya.

entries.name: Poison Doctrine V
entries.text: +140 all AP, +60 poison DMG, stacks up to 2x. Mandatory per Amya. STALE: guide's own cross-check note flags this as pre-nerf poison numbers — shortlist patch changed poison duration 6s->4s and poison damage per stack 250->140.

entries.name: Charge Doctrine V
entries.text: +250 charge DMG, +450 charge block break. Mandatory per Amya.

entries.name: Charge Defence Doctrine
entries.text: -40% DMG taken while charging. Mandatory per Amya.

entries.name: Charge CD Doctrine
entries.text: -24% charge CD, +1 charge target. Mandatory per Amya.

entries.name: LDS Doctrine
entries.text: Alt for Charge DMG / Charge Block Break if needed. Top pick.

entries.name: HP Doctrines
entries.text: Alt for Charge Defence: more fire resistance but worse trade vs Stalwart / Shieldmaiden charges. Top pick.

doctrines.note: Veterancy: Mixed (6 points Bot Line, rest Top). Hero pairing: not specified in this thread. Playstyle: same as Rattan Pikemen — goal is to debuff the enemy, charging in applies the debuff; disengage only if you can survive; 'insane piercing defence for their leadership / T2, great trade into pikes' is flagged by the guide itself as a pre-patch leadership figure (leadership has since risen 100->115, changing the cost-efficiency math this claim rests on). No dedicated Tips & Tricks section beyond the Playstyle bullets (OP gap, not fabricated). 'Filler'/'Don't put' are literal X placeholders in the OP. Rattan Roundshields is on the 2026-06-25 Chaos patch shortlist: Leadership 100->115 (Nerf), poison duration 6s->4s, poison damage per stack 250->140. This build/usage was drafted from a guide edited 2026-05-27, before the patch anchor -- the guide's own text explicitly flags this: the 'Poison Doctrine V' line ('+140 all AP, +60 poison DMG, stacks up to 2x') and the Playstyle claim 'insane piercing defence for their leadership / T2' both quote pre-nerf numbers per the guide's own in-file cross-check note. Both are reflected here as stale, not current.
